## Problem Statement
A clear description of the problem this feature would solve for newsrooms/publishers.

## Proposed Solution
Describe the feature you'd like to see.

## Publisher Use Case
How would a newsroom use this feature? Describe the reader/publisher workflow.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Phase Alignment
Which roadmap phase does this align with?
- [ ] Phase 2: Core Stripping
- [ ] Phase 3: Subscription Architecture
- [ ] Phase 4: Newsroom Features
- [ ] Phase 5: Performance
- [ ] Other: ___

## Priority
- [ ] Critical — Blocking adoption
- [ ] High — Significant publisher need
- [ ] Medium — Nice to have
- [ ] Low — Future consideration

## Additional Context
Add mockups, references, or links to similar implementations.
